courses.title: Full-Stack Web Development
courses.summary: Go from your first line of HTML to deploying a full web application with a React front end, a Node.js API and a database. You write code in every class, and your instructor reviews it with you.
outcomes: Build responsive pages with HTML, CSS and modern JavaScript
Write REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Design and query SQL and MongoDB databases
Use Git and GitHub the way teams do
Deploy an application to the cloud
forWho: Graduates who want a first job in software
Self-taught learners who want structure and feedback
courses.prereq: No coding experience needed. You should be comfortable using a computer and typing.

modules.title: Web foundations
topics: CSS layout with flexbox and grid

projects.title: Portfolio website
projects.desc: A responsive personal site you deploy in month two and keep improving.

projects.title: Task manager app
projects.desc: A React app with login, saved data and a REST API you write yourself.

projects.title: Capstone
projects.desc: A full-stack product you choose, built in a team and presented on demo day.

courses.desc: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Node.js. Build and deploy three projects, each reviewed line by line by your instructor.

courses.title: Data Analytics with Python and Power BI
courses.summary: Learn to turn messy business data into clear answers. You will clean, analyse and visualise real datasets using Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI, then present your findings like an analyst.
outcomes: Clean and organise data in Excel
Write SQL queries to pull and join data
Analyse data with Python and pandas
Pick the right chart for the question
forWho: Graduates from any stream with an interest in numbers
Professionals in finance, sales or operations
Anyone who works with spreadsheets every day
courses.prereq: Basic school maths and some familiarity with Excel. No programming needed.

projects.title: Sales performance report
projects.desc: An Excel and SQL analysis of a retail dataset with clear recommendations.

projects.title: Customer insights notebook
projects.desc: A Python analysis that segments customers and explains what drives repeat purchases.

projects.title: Executive dashboard
projects.desc: A Power BI dashboard built for a manager who has five minutes to read it.

courses.desc: Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI. Clean real datasets, find the story in them and present it as a dashboard.

courses.title: UI/UX Design
courses.summary: Learn how to design apps and websites people find easy to use. You will research real users, sketch and test ideas, and build polished prototypes in Figma.
outcomes: Map user journeys and information architecture
Apply typography, colour and layout principles
Build and use a design system
forWho: Students and graduates interested in design
Graphic designers moving into digital products
Developers who want to design better interfaces
courses.prereq: No design experience needed. A sense of curiosity about how things work helps.

projects.title: App redesign
projects.desc: Research and redesign a part of an app people complain about, backed by user tests.

projects.title: Design system
projects.desc: A small component library with colours, type and reusable components in Figma.

projects.title: Case study
projects.desc: A complete project from research to prototype, written up for your portfolio.

courses.desc: Research, wireframing and Figma prototyping. Finish with two case studies ready for your portfolio.

courses.title: Digital Marketing
courses.summary: Learn how businesses find customers online. You will plan and run real campaigns across search, social and email, and learn to read the numbers that show what is working.
outcomes: Run Google and Meta ad campaigns
forWho: Graduates looking for a marketing role
Freelancers who want to offer marketing services
courses.prereq: No prior experience needed. You should be comfortable using social media and the web.

projects.title: SEO audit
projects.desc: A full audit of a real local business website with a prioritised fix list.

projects.title: Ad campaign
projects.desc: A Google or Meta campaign you plan, run and optimise with a small budget.

projects.title: Marketing plan
projects.desc: A three-month plan for a business, presented to the class.

courses.desc: SEO, social media, Google Ads and analytics, practised on live campaigns with a real budget.

courses.title: Accounting with Tally and GST
courses.summary: Learn the accounting work a small business actually needs: keeping books, managing stock, running payroll and filing GST returns, all in Tally Prime.
outcomes: Maintain ledgers and prepare financial statements
Run payroll with PF and ESI
forWho: Accounts staff who want to upskill
Small business owners who keep their own books
courses.prereq: Basic knowledge of commerce or accounts helps but is not required.

projects.title: Company books
projects.desc: Set up and maintain a month of accounts for a sample trading business.

projects.title: GST filing
projects.desc: Prepare a full quarter of GST returns from invoices and purchases.

projects.title: Payroll run
projects.desc: Process salaries with deductions for a small team.

courses.desc: Bookkeeping, Tally Prime, GST returns and payroll, worked through with the paperwork a small business actually has.

courses.title: Spoken English and Interview Skills
courses.summary: Speak English with confidence at work and in interviews. Every class is practice: conversations, presentations, group discussions and mock interviews, with feedback each time.
outcomes: Speak clearly and confidently in everyday situations
forWho: Professionals who want to speak up more at work
courses.prereq: You should be able to read simple English. We place you in a group that matches your level.

projects.title: Self-introduction video
projects.desc: A recorded introduction you refine with feedback until it is interview-ready.

projects.title: Group discussion
projects.desc: A graded discussion on a current topic with peer and trainer feedback.

projects.title: Mock interview
projects.desc: A full recorded mock interview reviewed with you line by line.

courses.desc: Daily speaking practice, group discussions and mock interviews recorded and reviewed with you.
